section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measurement of consideration of cosmetic surgery using the Consider subscale of the ACSS (Appearance Comparison and Cosmetic Surgery Scale), which contains five items rated on a 7-point Likert scale. The subscale demonstrated high internal consistency (Cronbach's alpha = .92) in the present study. This section focuses on a measurement instrument for cosmetic surgery consideration rather than body appreciation or BMI assessment.
